facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Offers an AI Governance Readiness Check that assesses governance maturity, identifies risks and generates 'practical, defensible outputs in days instead of months'.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Serves two audiences: SMEs using AI but unsure about the risks, and ecosystem partners 'supporting hundreds of SMEs with one scalable intelligent governance tool'.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Plans: Essentials (a 10-minute assessment, a governance score, an initial executive snapshot); Professional (adds a 30-minute review call and an initial executive board report); Partner Licensing (custom, for firms that monitor AI governance across clients).

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Says it combines AI governance, regulatory and legal risk, AI assurance and audit readiness, human rights and ethical safeguards, public policy, and SME operational realities, where most solutions cover only one of legal, technical or policy.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: The check aims to move an organisation from 'We think our AI is governed' to 'We can demonstrate our AI is governed operationally and defensibly', looking at accountability, oversight, monitoring and evidence readiness.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: It says it follows the main UK and EU regulators relevant to AI, and offers real-time diagnostics when a company changes its strategy.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Operated by SUSTAIN-NOBILITY Advisory Ltd, registered in England and Wales.

told: It is selecting 15 pilot startups and is looking for design partners.
Both sides agreed the public company information can be published as a case study.

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: Sustain-Nobility assesses whether an organisation's AI governance can be demonstrated; RiskMandate measures, per agent, what it was asked to do, what it can actually reach, and the gap. Its assessments ask for evidence; we produce evidence, read-only, as a written record.

mandate.text: A readiness check states what each AI system is for and who is accountable: that is the mandate, in writing.

reach.text: Its public pages do not say how the reach of an organisation's agents (credentials, tools, data) is measured: unknown, and where RiskMandate's measurement fits.

gap.text: Its own words: from 'we think' to 'we can demonstrate'. The gap between mandate and reach, measured per agent, is that demonstration for agentic AI.

together.label: Our suggestions. Nothing here is agreed.

items.title: The evidence layer for its assessments
items.text: RiskMandate's mandate, reach and gap record as evidence behind a readiness score, for clients that run AI agents.
